verdict.rationale: Windows' first-party marketing documents organizing windows on screen with Snap layouts, which are predefined tiling layouts, and Snap groups for returning to window arrangements. That covers the core of the story. The evidence is a single marketing-level mention with no depth on how the layouts work. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the layout options and how to invoke them (keyboard shortcuts, hover menu), any evidence of customizable layouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
